inputs.prompt: The image is a wide realistic landscape photograph of a glacial valley at first light, the background a line of jagged snow-covered peaks standing against a pale clearing sky. A shallow braided river runs from the lower-left corner of the frame toward the centre, splitting around three low gravel bars before disappearing into the middle distance. Along the left side of the frame a steep scree slope rises out of the water, its surface broken grey rock with patches of rust-coloured lichen. On the right side of the frame a stand of perhaps thirty dark spruce climbs the lower slope, thinning to single trees further up. Across the upper third of the frame the peaks carry fresh snow on their upper faces and bare dark rock below the snowline, the furthest range paling into blue haze. In the lower-right corner a single weathered boulder sits half in the water, pale grey and streaked. Across the middle of the frame a low band of mist lies along the valley floor, thin enough to see the river through. The water is clear and shallow over pale gravel, showing the stones on the bed, and it runs glassy where it is deep and broken white where it drops over the bars. The lighting is low warm sun arriving from the right and just above the peaks, catching the snow on the upper faces in warm gold while the valley floor stays in cool blue shadow, with long soft shadows reaching left from the spruce. The overall composition is deep and layered with the river leading the eye into the frame, the palette built from cool blue-grey, warm gold and dark green, and the mood is still and cold.
